Bacterial infection reached the higher historical development level; currently it is inactive, while Granuloma inguinale is approved.; B. Granuloma inguinale reached the higher historical development level; currently it is inactive, while Bacterial infection is approved.; C. Bacterial infection reached the higher historical development level; currently it is approved, while Granuloma inguinale is inactive.; D. The two programs reached the same historical development level; currently both are approved.

options.label: A
options.text: Bacterial infection reached the higher historical development level; currently it is inactive, while Granuloma inguinale is approved.

options.label: B
options.text: Granuloma inguinale reached the higher historical development level; currently it is inactive, while Bacterial infection is approved.

options.label: C
options.text: Bacterial infection reached the higher historical development level; currently it is approved, while Granuloma inguinale is inactive.

options.label: D
options.text: The two programs reached the same historical development level; currently both are approved.
